# Julius third live mission workspace

A throwaway repository, and deliberately not either earlier mission's task. The
first normalised a string; the second reduced a list of records. This one
decides whether a path stays inside a boundary — different shape, different edge
cases, and a rule whose refusals a reviewer can actually check one by one.

4 MiB, no network, no dependencies, and no path back to the Sunday Relay
repository. The mission's own contract states what must be built here.
